scope: Genus-one formulas with explicit prime/binary namespaces, model equations and native Weierstrass maps. Counts are entries, not algebraically independent identities.
domain_policy: Equality assumptions are retained; nonzero-denominator and completeness conditions are not universally encoded. Consult the source and explicit operation contracts. Unified never implies complete.

verification_semantics.finite_field_checked: Checked on stated finite fields and affine domains, not a proof of completeness or symbolic correctness for every field.
verification_semantics.inherited_not_rechecked: Existing export entry retained; not covered by the new independent arithmetic checks.
verification_semantics.syntax_checked_only: Parsed and compiled, not yet checked against group arithmetic.
